newsitem.title: UK: IBCA assigns Wuerth Group L-term A, S-term A1.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns Wuerth Group L-term A, S-term A1.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Monday it had assigned a long-term rating of A and a short-term rating A1, to Wuerth Group, one of the world's largest specialists in the supply and distribution of assembly technology.

It said the group generated DEM4.9 billion in turnover during FY96 from operations in 61 countries, supplying fixture fitments (screws, bolts, nails etc.), auto components (aerials, sealants) and other generally low unit value raw material inputs.
It said international diversification had taken on an increasingly important role in group activities: 52% of sales and 71% of pre-tax profits in FY96 arose outside Germany.

"Profitability has improved from a low-point in the early 1990s, as higher margin international operations have grown and the benefits of heavy investment in IT and new warehousing facilities in the core German market have fed through," said IBCA in a statement.

It said the DEM1bn capital investment programme at the beginning of the decade was largely debt financed but added growth in retained earnings from DEM369m at YE93 to DEM801m at YE94 has seen balance sheet gearing fall from 109% to 55% at YE96.
"Retention of profits for reinvestment is crucial, in view of the constraints imposed on the equity base by family ownership," it said.
